label: Enable Camera Scanning

label: Ask Qty After Selecting an Item

label: Add Each Item on a New Line
name: POS Profile-posa_new_line

label: Use QZ Tray for Silent Print
description: Print invoices, orders and payment receipts straight to the printer through QZ Tray, without the browser print dialog. If QZ Tray is not running, the browser print opens as before.
name: POS Profile-posa_silent_print

label: QZ Tray Printer Name
description: Default printer name as QZ Tray lists it. Each terminal can choose its own printer from the POS menu: QZ Tray Printer.
name: POS Profile-posa_qz_printer_name

label: Use Raw Receipt Printing
description: Send invoices, orders and payment receipts to QZ Tray as ESC/POS raw commands instead of the HTML print format. Faster, and works for offline sales too.
name: POS Profile-posa_raw_printing

label: Raw Receipt Width
description: Characters per line: 42 for 80mm printers, 32 for 58mm printers.
name: POS Profile-posa_raw_print_width

description: Cache items, barcodes, prices, stock, customers and offers on the terminal (IndexedDB) and keep selling when the server is unreachable. Invoices taken offline are queued and synced automatically.
label: Offline Mode
name: POS Profile-posa_offline_section

description: How often the terminal pulls changed items, prices, stock and customers in the background.
label: Catalogue Sync Interval (minutes)
name: POS Profile-posa_offline_sync_interval

name: POS Profile-posa_sales_person

label: Use Server Cache

label: VFD Command Set
name: POS Profile-posa_vfd_command_set

label: Customer Pole Display (VFD)
name: POS Profile-posa_vfd_section

description: Empty = WELCOME
label: Display Line 1 (idle)
name: POS Profile-posa_vfd_line_1

description: Empty = company name

name: POS Profile-posa_vfd_line_2

label: Use Limit Search
name: POS Profile-pose_use_limit_search

description: For Sales Partner Payment Reconciliation
label: Sales Partner
name: POS Profile-sales_partner

description: Set when the invoice was taken while the POS was offline.
label: Offline ID
name: Sales Invoice-posa_offline_id

label: Allow Sales Persons on each Items
name: Sales Invoice-posa_sales_person

label: Is Offer Replace For item Row ID
name: Sales Invoice Item-posa_is_replace

description: Exchange or replace items of an earlier sale from the Return dialog: a credit note for the returned items and a new invoice for the replacement items, linked by a POS Item Exchange record.
label: Item Exchange / Replacement
name: POS Profile-posa_exchange_section

description: Return items of an earlier sale and sell other items in their place; the difference is paid or refunded.
label: Enable Item Exchange
name: POS Profile-posa_enable_item_exchange

description: Swap returned items for the same items (e.g. faulty ones), same quantity, at the price originally paid.
label: Enable Item Replacement
name: POS Profile-posa_enable_item_replacement

description: Replacement items may cost more; the customer pays the difference.
label: Allow Exchange with Additional Payment
name: POS Profile-posa_allow_exchange_additional_payment

description: Replacement items may cost less; the difference is refunded to the customer.
label: Allow Exchange with Refund
name: POS Profile-posa_allow_exchange_refund

description: A user with the approver role must approve every exchange (their login, or their user and password on this terminal).
label: Require Manager Approval
name: POS Profile-posa_exchange_require_approval

description: Set on the credit note and the new invoice of an item exchange.
label: POS Item Exchange
name: Sales Invoice-posa_item_exchange

label: Offline Invoices (v14 setting)
name: POS Profile-posa_enable_offline_invoices
description: Kept from v14. Either tick turns offline mode on; untick this one to use only Enable Offline Mode.

name: POS Profile-posa_fd_section
label: Fine Dining
description: Table service features for fine dining. Each one can be switched on or off; with Enable Fine Dining off the POS works as before.

name: POS Profile-posa_fd_covers
label: Ask Number of Guests (Covers)
description: Asks the number of guests when a table is chosen; shown on the order, kitchen tickets and pre-bill.

name: POS Profile-posa_fd_seats
label: Seat Numbers on Items
description: Each item gets a seat number (0 = shared), so the kitchen and the bill know who ordered what.

name: POS Profile-posa_fd_modifiers
label: Item Modifiers
description: Choices such as doneness, sides and paid add-ons, set up in POS Modifier Group.

name: POS Profile-posa_fd_courses
label: Courses with Hold / Fire
description: Items get a course (POS Course). Courses marked Hold Until Fired go to the kitchen only when the waiter fires them.

name: POS Profile-posa_fd_void_control
label: Void / Comp with Reason
description: Removing or reducing an item already sent to the kitchen needs a reason (POS Void Reason), is logged in POS Void Log and sends a VOID ticket to the kitchen. Comp makes an item free with a reason.

name: POS Profile-posa_fd_prebill
label: Pre-Bill (Guest Check)
description: Prints the bill for the table before payment, marked as not a tax invoice. Never sent to FBR.

name: POS Profile-posa_fd_floor_plan
label: Floor Plan and Table Moves
description: The floor with live table status (Seated, Ordered, Waiting, Bill, Cleaning); open an order from its table, move it to another table, merge tables, move items between orders, hand a table to another waiter. Tables are placed by their Layout Position (X, Y, Width, Height).

name: POS Profile-posa_fd_table_cleaning
label: Tables Need Cleaning After Payment
description: A paid table shows Cleaning until someone marks it Available on the floor plan.

name: POS Profile-posa_fd_split_bill
label: Split Bill
description: Split an order into separate checks by seat or by item, or print equal shares on the guest check.

name: POS Profile-posa_fd_service_charge
label: Service Charge
description: Adds a Service Charge row (% of the net total) to dine-in orders. Not added to sales made offline.

name: POS Profile-posa_fd_service_charge_min_covers
label: Service Charge From Guests
description: 0 = every dine-in order; e.g. 6 = parties of 6 or more

name: POS Profile-posa_fd_tips
label: Tips
description: The waiter or cashier adds a tip (amount or %) before payment; it is collected with the bill and posted to the Tips Account.

name: POS Profile-posa_fd_tips_account
label: Tips Account
description: Usually a liability account (tips payable to staff)

name: POS Profile-posa_fd_expo
label: Expo (Pass) Screen
description: The Expo page (/desk/fd_expo) shows each table's courses: held, cooking, ready, served. The pass marks a course served.

name: POS Profile-posa_fd_kds_item_bump
label: Kitchen: Finish Single Items and Recall
description: On the kitchen display a cook taps an item when it is done (the ticket is Ready when all are); Recall brings back a finished ticket.

name: POS Profile-posa_fd_prep_minutes
label: Kitchen Target Minutes
description: 0 = off. Tickets turn amber at 75% of the target and red past it. An item's own Prep Minutes win.

name: POS Profile-posa_fd_86
label: 86 List (Unavailable Dishes)
description: Dishes marked 86 (from the kitchen display or the POS) cannot be ordered; every terminal is told at once.

name: POS Profile-posa_fd_allergens
label: Allergens
description: Allergens on items (Item > Allergens, list in POS Allergen) and the guests' allergies on the order. Matching items are flagged on the kitchen ticket and the waiter is warned.

label: Guest Allergies
name: Sales Invoice-posa_allergies
description: Comma separated, e.g. Peanuts, Gluten

label: Prep Minutes
name: Item-posa_prep_minutes
description: Kitchen target for tickets with this item (fine dining)

label: Unavailable Today (86)
name: Item-posa_86
description: Set from the kitchen display or the POS; such items cannot be ordered

name: POS Profile-posa_fd_reservations
label: Reservations and Waitlist
description: POS Reservation: bookings with table, time, guests, deposit; walk-ins on the waitlist. The floor shows Reserved before a booking; Seat opens the order with the guests and allergies.

name: POS Profile-posa_fd_guest_profiles
label: Guest Profiles
description: VIP, preferences, allergies, birthday and anniversary on the Customer, with visits, average spend and favourite dishes, shown when the guest is chosen.

name: POS Profile-posa_fd_feedback
label: Guest Feedback
description: The guest check prints a link and QR code to a short feedback form (/pos_feedback); answers are in POS Guest Feedback.

label: Preferences
name: Customer-posa_guest_preferences
description: e.g. window table, sparkling water, no ice

label: Allergies
name: Customer-posa_guest_allergies
description: Comma separated; copied to the order when this guest is chosen

name: POS Profile-posa_fd_waiter_offline
label: Waiter App Works Offline
description: Needs Enable Offline Mode (Offline and Devices tab). The waiter app keeps the item catalogue on the tablet; when the Wi-Fi drops, Make KOT keeps the order on the tablet and sends it to the server (and the kitchen) as soon as the connection is back.

label: Training Sale
name: Sales Invoice-posa_training
description: Made in training mode: never submitted, removed when the shift closes

name: POS Profile-posa_sm_section
label: Supermarket
description: Retail / supermarket features for the RMS POS. Each one is switched on or off on its own; with Enable Supermarket Features off nothing here is used and the POS works as before.

name: POS Profile-posa_sm_manager_approval
label: Manager Approval (PIN / Card)
description: A manager approves the actions ticked here with a PIN or by scanning a manager card. Every approval is kept in POS Approval Log.

name: POS Profile-posa_sm_approval_offline
label: When the Till Is Offline
description: Not Allowed: these actions wait for the connection. Allow and Log: they are allowed without a PIN and logged as Offline for review.

name: POS Profile-posa_sm_discount_limit
label: Discount Allowed Without Approval
description: A manual discount above this % (an item or the whole sale) needs a manager. Offers, coupons and the customer's own discount do not count.

name: POS Profile-posa_sm_appr_price
label: Price Override
description: Lowering an item's rate by hand

name: POS Profile-posa_sm_appr_line_void
label: Line Void
description: Removing an item from the cart

name: POS Profile-posa_sm_appr_cart_void
label: Cart Void
description: Cancelling the whole cart

name: POS Profile-posa_sm_appr_return
label: Returns
description: Starting a return (with or without the original invoice)

name: POS Profile-posa_sm_managers
label: Managers
description: The users who can approve on these tills. Each one sets a PIN (and optionally a card) in POS Manager PIN; the PIN never goes to the tills.

name: POS Profile-posa_sm1c_section
label: Cash Control: Voids, Drawer and Shift

name: POS Profile-posa_sm_void_reason
label: Void With Reason
description: Removing an item or cancelling the cart asks a reason (POS Void Reason); kept in POS Void Log.

name: POS Profile-posa_sm_training_mode
label: Training Mode
description: Practice sales: nothing is posted, sent to FBR or taken from stock. Trainees below always sell in training mode; other cashiers can switch it on from the menu.

name: POS Profile-posa_sm_cash_drawer
label: Cash Drawer (QZ Tray)
description: Opens the drawer connected to the receipt printer through QZ Tray, and adds No Sale to the menu (asks a reason; kept in POS Drawer Log).

name: POS Profile-posa_sm_drawer_on_cash
label: Open the Drawer on Cash Sales

name: POS Profile-posa_sm_drawer_code
label: Drawer Pulse Code
description: ESC/POS bytes sent to the printer. 27,112,0,25,250 = drawer 1 (most printers); 27,112,1,25,250 = drawer 2.

name: POS Profile-posa_sm_cash_pickup
label: Cash Pickup and Cash In / Out
description: Menu actions to take cash to the safe, put float in or pay cash out, with a reason (POS Cash Movement). They are counted in the expected cash at closing.

name: POS Profile-posa_sm_drawer_limit
label: Drawer Cash Limit
description: The cashier is told to make a pickup when the cash in the drawer passes this. 0 = no reminder.

name: POS Profile-posa_sm_safe_account
label: Safe Account (Pickups)
description: Optional. When set, a pickup posts a Journal Entry from the cash account to this account.

name: POS Profile-posa_sm_cash_in_out_account
label: Cash In / Out Account
description: Optional. When set, Cash In and Cash Out post a Journal Entry against this account.

name: POS Profile-posa_sm_xz_report
label: X / Z Reports
description: X Report (shift so far) in the menu. For the Z Report at closing choose the print format "Z Report" as the closing shift print format.

name: POS Profile-posa_sm_blind_close
label: Blind Close
description: At closing the cashier counts the cash without seeing the expected amounts; over / short is kept on the closing shift.

name: POS Profile-posa_sm_quick_keys
label: Quick Keys
description: A Quick Keys button opens big buttons for items without a barcode (fruit, vegetables, bread), in pages set up in POS Quick Key Page.

name: POS Profile-posa_sm_ask_weight
label: Ask Weight for Weighed Items
description: Items sold by weight (UOMs below) ask the weight when added by search or quick key; scale labels keep their own weight.

name: POS Profile-posa_sm_weighed_uoms
label: Weighed UOMs
description: Comma separated, e.g. Kg, Gram

name: POS Profile-posa_sm_scale_reading
label: Read Weight From Scale
description: Reads the weight from a scale connected to the till (USB / serial, Chrome or Edge). Menu > Connect Scale the first time.

name: POS Profile-posa_sm_scale_protocol
label: Scale Protocol
description: Continuous: the scale sends its weight all the time. CAS: CAS lines (ST / US). Toledo: Mettler Toledo continuous. Request: the till asks with the command below.

name: POS Profile-posa_sm_scale_request
label: Scale Request Command
description: Sent to ask the weight, e.g. W, P or $ (\r is added).

name: POS Profile-posa_sm_qty_times
label: Qty x Scan
description: Type 12* (or 12x) in the search box: the next item is added 12 times. 12*code in one go works too.

name: POS Profile-posa_sm_gs1_barcodes
label: GS1 Barcodes
description: Reads GS1-128 / DataBar codes: product (01), weight (310n), price (392n), count (30 / 37), batch (10), expiry (17). Needs the offline catalogue. Price-embedded EAN-13 labels use the scale label settings (Offline and Devices tab, value type Price).

name: POS Profile-posa_sm_hotkeys
label: Custom Hotkeys
description: Choose the keys of the till actions below. Keys not listed keep their usual meaning.

name: POS Profile-posa_sm_mix_match
label: Mix and Match Deals
description: POS Deal of type Mix and Match: any items of the lists count together (any 3 for Rs 999).

name: POS Profile-posa_sm_multibuy
label: Multi-Buy Deals
description: POS Deal of type Multi-Buy: the same item, e.g. 3 for Rs 500 (6 for 1000 with Repeat).

name: POS Profile-posa_sm_offer_schedule
label: Time and Day Offers
description: POS Offers with Daily From / To or Days apply only then (happy hour, Friday deals). Deals always follow their own times.

name: POS Profile-posa_sm_markdown_labels
label: Reduced-Price Labels (Markdowns)
description: POS Markdown makes reduced-price labels (near expiry, damaged pack); scanning one sells that item at its reduced price, once per label.

name: POS Profile-posa_sm_savings_receipt
label: You Saved on the Receipt
description: The raw (QZ) receipt shows the savings by kind; print format POS Receipt Savings shows them on HTML receipts.

label: Reduced Label
name: Sales Invoice Item-posa_sm_markdown
description: The reduced-price (markdown) label sold on this line

name: POS Profile-posa_sm_gift_cards
label: Gift Cards
description: Sell and top up gift cards (POS Gift Card) and take them as payment. Menu > Gift Card.

name: POS Profile-posa_sm_gift_card_item
label: Gift Card Item
description: A non-stock item sold to load a card; its income account should be the gift card liability account.

name: POS Profile-posa_sm_gift_card_mop
label: Gift Card Mode of Payment
description: Add it to the payment methods of this profile; its account should be the same liability account.

name: POS Profile-posa_sm_gift_card_expiry_days
label: Card Valid For (Days)
description: 0 = no expiry

name: POS Profile-posa_sm_store_credit
label: Refund Returns as Store Credit
description: A return can be refunded on a gift card (a new store credit card or an existing card).

name: POS Profile-posa_sm_wallet_qr
label: Wallet / Raast QR
description: Payments in the modes below show a QR code with the amount for the customer to scan; the cashier confirms (and types the transaction ID).

name: POS Profile-posa_sm_card_terminal
label: Card Payments: Approval Code
description: Card payments need the approval code from the card machine slip, or come from a card machine bridge on the till.

name: POS Profile-posa_sm_card_mops
label: Card Modes of Payment
description: Comma separated, e.g. Credit Card, Debit Card

name: POS Profile-posa_sm_card_bridge_url
label: Card Machine Bridge URL
description: Optional, e.g. http://localhost:8765/pay. The till sends the amount there and waits for the approval (see help).

name: POS Profile-posa_sm_e_receipt
label: E-Receipt (WhatsApp / SMS)
description: Sends the receipt to the customer's phone after the sale: customers with Send E-Receipts ticked, or a number asked at payment.

name: POS Profile-posa_sm_e_receipt_channel
label: Send By
description: WhatsApp needs the WhatsBridge app; SMS uses ERPNext SMS Settings.

name: POS Profile-posa_sm_e_receipt_format
label: Receipt As
description: PDF: WhatsApp only, printed with the print format below (it is saved as a public file).

name: POS Profile-posa_sm_e_receipt_ask
label: Ask the Number at Payment
description: Asks for a number when the customer has none (walk-in).

name: POS Profile-posa_sm_loyalty_display
label: Loyalty Points on the Customer Display
description: With the pole display on: the customer's points show when the customer is chosen.

name: POS Profile-posa_sm_age_check
label: Age-Restricted Items
description: Items with a Minimum Age to Buy (Item > Supermarket) ask the cashier to check the customer's age, once per sale.

label: Gift Card No
name: Sales Invoice Item-posa_sm_gift_card
description: The gift card this line sells or tops up

label: Send E-Receipts
name: Customer-posa_sm_e_receipt
description: Receipts of POS sales go to the customer's mobile number (WhatsApp / SMS)

label: Minimum Age to Buy
name: Item-posa_sm_min_age
description: e.g. 18 for cigarettes. The till asks the cashier to check the customer's age (Supermarket > Age-Restricted Items).

name: POS Profile-posa_sm_shelf_labels
label: Shelf-Edge Labels
description: Price changes of this profile's selling price list (and offers / deals) queue shelf labels; print them from the Shelf Labels page. Off: nothing is queued; Multi Barcode Labels works as before.

name: POS Profile-posa_sm_label_template
label: Label Template
description: The default template; standard ones are made the first time this is switched on.

name: POS Profile-posa_sm_label_printer
label: Label Printer (QZ Tray)
description: The QZ Tray name of the label printer for ZPL / TSPL templates. Empty = the default printer.

name: POS Profile-posa_sm_label_on_offer
label: Queue When Offers / Deals Start or End

name: POS Profile-posa_sm_label_min_change
label: Ignore Price Changes Below
description: e.g. 1: a change of less than Rs 1 does not queue a label

name: POS Profile-posa_sm_label_name2_field
label: Second Name Field
description: Optional: the Item field with the second (e.g. Urdu) name, such as custom_urdu_name; shown as name2 on labels.

name: POS Profile-posa_sm_stock_count
label: Stock Count From Handheld
description: Page Stock Count and Receiving: count by scanning (works offline), then make a Stock Reconciliation draft.

name: POS Profile-posa_sm_blind_count
label: Blind Count
description: The counter does not see the system quantity.

name: POS Profile-posa_sm_store_receiving
label: Goods Receiving
description: Same page: receive a Purchase Order by scanning; shortages and extras are shown; makes a Purchase Receipt draft.

name: POS Profile-posa_sm_transfer_request
label: Request Stock From the Till
description: Menu > Request Stock: a Material Request (transfer) to this profile's warehouse.

name: POS Profile-posa_sm_low_stock
label: Low-Stock List
description: Menu > Low Stock: items of this warehouse at or below their re-order level (Item > Auto Re-order).

name: POS Profile-posa_pwa
label: Install as App and Start Offline (PWA)
description: The POS, waiter app and price checker can be installed as an app (Chrome / Edge: Install in the address bar) and open even when the server cannot be reached, from the copy kept at the last online start. Needs https. Works best with Enable Offline Mode. Untick to remove it from the devices at their next start.

name: POS Profile-posa_sm6_section
label: Management
description: Screens and reports for the store manager. Each one covers the POS Profiles where it is ticked.

name: POS Profile-posa_sm_till_monitor
label: Till Monitor
description: The tills report every minute (online, offline invoices waiting or failed, last upload). Page Till Monitor shows every till with its cashier, shift, last sale and sales today.

name: POS Profile-posa_sm_dashboard
label: Manager Dashboard
description: Page Manager Dashboard: sales, invoices, basket size, items per basket, returns, discounts and voids, sales per hour, per till and per cashier, top items. Refreshes every minute.

name: POS Profile-posa_sm_loss_reports
label: Loss-Prevention Report
description: Report POS Loss Prevention: voids, No Sales, price overrides, discounts, returns and refused approvals per cashier or per shift, with the void and return rates.

name: POS Profile-posa_sm_offer_reports
label: Offer Effectiveness Report
description: Report POS Offer Effectiveness: per POS Offer, deal and reduced label: sales, items, discount given, margin, and the items' sales against the same number of days before.

name: POS Profile-posa_sm_movers
label: Fast / Slow Movers Report
description: Report POS Fast and Slow Movers: items sold, sales per day, days of stock left, last sold, fast (the items making 80% of the quantity), slow and dead stock.

name: POS Profile-posa_sm_slow_days
label: Dead Stock After (Days Without a Sale)
